purpose: Research-only handoff for nums 726-745 in data-mcudc.js. Built from live Common Sense Media refetches of catalog srcUrl pages. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This refetch preserves CSM's current visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Production catalog edits should be made only by the follow-up importer/reviewer.

entries.title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns Part 1

violence.summary: Graphic animated combat includes repeated beatings, stabbing, eye injury, knife-gang threats, a bloody parental-murder flashback, a race crash, and Batman firing from a tank-like vehicle.

language.summary: A few mild-to-moderate swear words and religious exclamations appear.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: Adult whiskey drinking appears, and a teen repeatedly overhears exaggerated adult references to drugs, highs, and memory lapses.

violence.summary: Mostly effects-driven but intense violence includes burning and decaying bodies, a mother and young teen being attacked, kidnapping, needle injection, gunfire, crashes, explosions, deaths, and scary skull imagery.

language.summary: Infrequent but stronger language includes one F-word plus moderate profanity, insults, and crude terms.

romance.summary: Brief animated rear nudity and one implied pickup-for-sex moment are mentioned, with little explicit content.

drinking.summary: A secondary character is described as alcoholic and briefly drinks wine or from a flask; a near-cigarette-lighting moment appears.

violence.summary: Heavy superhero fighting uses fists, fantasy weapons, super-strength, fire, burial, bombs, shootings with blood, an animal attack, and a world-destruction threat.

language.summary: Only a few mild profanities are noted.

romance.summary: Skimpy superhero costumes, minor bar flirting, and one brief attractiveness comment are flagged.

drinking.summary: A birthday scene occurs in a bar, but the relevant character refuses a drink he believes is alcoholic.

violence.summary: Violence is central, with frequent pummeling, smashing, war imagery, torture of villains, brief blood from facial injuries, and a child endangered in a flashback.

language.summary: Frequent British slang, mild-to-moderate profanity, insults, crude phrases, and religious exclamations appear.

romance.summary: There is repeated innuendo aimed at Superman, married banter with Lois, kissing, and Lois in sleepwear.

drinking.summary: One character is usually drinking and acknowledges needing to sober up, while a flashback includes a mean drunken father.

violence.summary: Large-scale superhero combat includes city destruction, alien armies, explosions, many implied casualties, discussion of nuclear weapons, a notable supporting-character death, injuries, and creepy alien enemies.

language.summary: A few moderate swears, mild profanities, and religious exclamations appear.

romance.summary: Light flirting, tight costumes, and brief non-explicit male nudity after a transformation are noted.

drinking.summary: Champagne toasts, one self-mixed drink, and a brief marijuana reference appear.

violence.summary: Realistic-feeling violence includes neck-breaking, stabbing, hostage-taking, executions, torture, a plane takeover, explosions, building collapse, shootings, severe injury to Bruce, and a dead teen body.

language.summary: Language is sparse, with occasional mild-to-moderate profanity, religious exclamations, and insults.

romance.summary: Bruce kisses two women; one kiss leads to implied offscreen sex followed by bare-shouldered cuddling.

drinking.summary: Adults drink cocktails at formal Gotham events.

entries.title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns Part 2

violence.summary: Nearly constant animated combat includes guns, shooting, punching, stabbing, visible blood, bodies, a nuclear blast, chaos, riots, looting, and mob violence.

language.summary: A small amount of mild-to-moderate profanity appears.

romance.summary: An escort-service subplot includes kissing with sexual suggestion, and one villainess has strategically covered apparent nudity.

drinking.summary: Secondary characters drink as a coping mechanism, with drinking problems suggested indirectly.

violence.summary: Public bombings, staged executions, an on-camera assassination setup, a missile attack on a home, casual guard deaths, and a large battle with mutated soldiers make the violence more human-centered than earlier Iron Man entries.

language.summary: Moderate profanity, insults, crude terms, and religious exclamations are noted.

romance.summary: Content includes Tony and Pepper kissing, a one-night-stand flashback, women in underwear or bikinis, suggestive joking, and swimsuit-pageant scenes.

drinking.summary: Characters drink at a party and bar; one character mentions past substance trouble and is seen drinking beer.

entries.title: Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox

violence.summary: Frequent animated violence includes a murdered mother discovered by her child, a severed head, death by hanging, bloody punching, a tsunami, and constant superhero battle.

language.summary: Scattered mild-to-moderate profanity appears.

romance.summary: The only flagged item is a parent asking her son whether he is gay in an accepting way.

drinking.summary: Batman's father briefly drinks from a flask.

handoffNotes: Emotional grief around Flash's murdered mother should remain visible in prose outside numeric flags.

entries.title: Man of Steel

violence.summary: The page labels violence as some despite extensive destruction: collapsing buildings, downed aircraft, child and adult peril, a destroyed planet, fast combat with deaths, choking, and Superman killing an enemy.

language.summary: Occasional profanity includes mild-to-moderate words, crude insults, religious exclamations, and one abbreviated stronger term.

romance.summary: Lois and Clark share longing looks, hand-holding, and a couple of kisses.

drinking.summary: A bar-restaurant scene includes adult drinking, including Scotch.

handoffNotes: CSM violence label is only 'some' while the detailed prose describes mass destruction, deaths, choking, and a neck-breaking; review if the app should follow label or prose intensity.

violence.summary: Heavy animated action includes super-powered beatings, terrorists with guns and bomb threats, city and planetary threats, missiles, small amounts of blood, and a gory transformation image.

language.summary: A few religious exclamations and a rude double-finger gesture appear.

romance.summary: Clark and Lois have a romantic adult relationship with quarrels and kissing, while Lois and Supergirl wear revealing outfits and Jimmy reacts to Supergirl's attractiveness.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drugs, or smoking concerns.

entries.title: The Wolverine

violence.summary: Frequent bloody action includes claws, knives, swords, guns, maiming, soldiers killing themselves or others, brutal hand combat, a major explosion, venom injection, blistering skin, and arrow wounds.

language.summary: Infrequent but stronger profanity includes one F-word alongside moderate swears and religious exclamations.

romance.summary: Kissing, flirting, implied sex under covers, a three-person underwear-clad kissing scene, and a revealingly dressed villain are noted.

drinking.summary: A lonely man drinks whiskey, and there is additional bar and party drinking.

handoffNotes: CSM notes melancholy and grief around Logan's past; preserve that emotional content in prose if surfaced.

violence.summary: Action includes explosions, knife and gun fights, slapping, broad landscape destruction, stabbing, shooting, and killing, with limited blood.

language.summary: A few mild profanities and one stronger phrase are noted.

romance.summary: Kissing, flirting, and a brief nonsexual blurred nude-man gag appear.

drinking.summary: Some celebratory drinking is shown.

entries.title: Batman: Assault on Arkham

violence.summary: CSM labels violence as some, while details include frequent violence, exploding or shattered frozen heads, hanging bodies, gunfire, stabbings, and joking references to abuse of Harley Quinn.

language.summary: Regular profanity includes moderate swears, insults, crude terms, and a middle-finger gesture.

romance.summary: Sexual insinuation, Harley undressing from behind, and two antagonists nearly having sex are flagged.

drinking.summary: Some drinking is present.

handoffNotes: CSM's 'some' violence label may understate graphic details such as exploding heads and hanging bodies; review label-versus-detail mapping before import.

entries.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier

violence.summary: Frequent stylized action includes heavy fighting, shooting, falls, crashes, little blood, shield attacks, a brutal Winter Soldier fight, explosions, and property damage.

language.summary: Language is described as limited, but CSM still labels it some because stronger words are audible during noisy fight scenes.

romance.summary: Cap and Black Widow share a cover kiss; dating teasing and interrupted flirting remain mild.

drinking.summary: Villains sip champagne during a meeting.

handoffNotes: Language label is 'some' even though CSM detail says very little language; preserve the CSM label but review if detail-based mapper would lower it.

entries.title: Guardians of the Galaxy

violence.summary: Action includes hand combat, fistfights, shootouts, explosions, apparent and real deaths, heartbreaking losses, a fighter-fleet explosion, and threatened planetary destruction, with little gore.

language.summary: Occasional stronger and moderate profanity, insults, crude terms, and an extended middle-finger gesture appear.

romance.summary: Peter's sexual reputation is referenced, he and Gamora have near-kisses, he appears in boxer briefs, and one prison escape suggestion is sexually transactional.

drinking.summary: Characters drink an implied alcoholic liquid to drunkenness, and post-credits characters drink liquor and a martini.

handoffNotes: Opening parental death and another heartfelt death/near-death are emotional content that should remain visible in prose.

violence.summary: Unrelenting animated superhero combat includes frequent fights, battles, swordplay, characters thrown into walls and buildings, bullying, and taunting.

language.summary: Moderate profanity, insults, and a sexist insult directed at Wonder Woman are noted.

romance.summary: A brief cross-dressing reference appears in a lasso-of-truth scene.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drugs, or smoking concerns.

entries.title: Son of Batman

violence.summary: Frequent violence includes swords, arrows, machine guns, throat and eye stabbings, point-blank shooting, a burning death, and a tween pinned to a wall by blades through his arms.

language.summary: A few mild-to-moderate profanities and hostile phrases appear.

romance.summary: Suggestive remarks include a biting innuendo, a phone-sex reference, a sperm-donor insult, and a villain bringing prostitutes to his apartment.

drinking.summary: Characters drink alcohol but are not shown intoxicated.

handoffNotes: Father-son conflict and Damian's violent upbringing may need prose context beyond the scored categories.

violence.summary: Super-powered combat includes destruction, menace, people thrown, stabbed, and shot at, visible corpses and skeletons, explosions, and uprooted structures.

language.summary: A few moderate profanities plus one F-word are listed.

romance.summary: A man's rear nudity after getting out of bed beside a woman, bar flirting, and Mystique's nude-looking blue form are flagged.

drinking.summary: Young Xavier injects a serum in a way that mimics drug use, with close-up needle imagery; he also drinks heavily amid many bottles, plus other social drinking.

entries.title: Ant-Man

violence.summary: Frequent sci-fi action includes disintegration deaths reduced to goo, dead lab sheep, a beloved ant's death, a long shootout, bloody bruising, crashes, and a brief child-grabbing moment.

language.summary: Occasional stronger language includes moderate profanity, crude terms, mild swears, and insults.

romance.summary: Kissing, suggestive couple behavior, comments about women being attractive, and one breast-touching reference are noted.

drinking.summary: Adults drink champagne, beer, and wine socially without excess.

handoffNotes: Parent-child separation between Scott and Cassie could upset younger viewers and should remain in prose if the app surfaces emotional content.
